content.trans: 所以美国的医疗问题现在很激烈辩论，因为很多人。

content.text: don't have healthcare and it's not very accessible, right?
content.trans: 您不拥有医疗保障，这并不太方便吗？

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And it's a huge debate because it's very, very divided by party lines.
content.trans: 而且这是一个巨大的争论，因为它非常分裂党派立场。

content.text: We say, you know, there's the Republicans on the right and there's the Democrats on the left.
content.trans: 我们说，您知道，有右派的共和党人和左派的民主党人。

content.text: And the Democrats want a public healthcare option.
content.trans: 和民主党希望一个公共医疗选项。

content.text: They want healthcare to be available for everyone, for free.
content.trans: 他们希望医疗保健能够为所有人提供免费。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: And many of them do.
content.trans: 和他们很多。

content.text: And a lot of Republicans say no, it should be private because if it's private, there's competition.
content.trans: 并且很多共和党人说不行，应该私有，因为如果私有化了，就会竞争。

content.text: And that means there's better healthcare.
content.trans: 而且意味着有更好的医疗保健。

content.text: And so there's a really big debate and people are getting very angry about it.
content.trans: 因此，人们对此争论不休，并且很多人对它感到非常愤怒。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: But I think it's something that's very interesting and most importantly,
content.trans: 但是我认为这是一件非常有趣且最重要的事情。

content.text: seeing the difference of healthcare systems around the world, right?
content.trans: 看全球不同医疗系统之间的区别吗？

content.text: So for example, our listeners, they're from everywhere in the world.
content.trans: 所以，例如，我们的听众来自世界各地。

content.text: So we would like to know what the healthcare system is like there.
content.trans: 所以，我们希望了解那里医疗卫生系统的情况。

content.text: Do you have free universal healthcare in your country?
content.trans: 您在您的国家是否有免费的全民医疗保障？

content.text: Or do you also have to pay for private companies or private health insurance?
content.trans: 您是否也必须为私人公司或私人医疗保险支付费用？

content.text: And if you have one or the other system, do you think it's a good thing?
content.trans: 如果只有一个或另一个系统，你觉得这是个好主意吗？

content.text: Do you think it's a bad thing?
content.trans: 是的，我认为这是一件坏事。

content.text: What do you think needs some work?
content.trans: 您认为需要改进什么？

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: I definitely agree with universal healthcare.
content.trans: 我完全同意全面医疗保障。

content.text: I think it's a relief because it's like one thing less to worry about.
content.trans: 我认为这是一件好事，因为它比原来少了一份忧虑。

content.text: I can't imagine like, you know, if I don't have healthcare right now and I'm not covered
content.trans: 我无法想象，你可能不知道，如果我现在没有医疗保障，或者我不被覆盖。

content.text: by a private company and something happens to me tomorrow, then, you know,
content.trans: 根据一个私人公司，然后事情会发生，那么你一定知道。

content.text: what's going to happen?
content.trans: 请问会发生什么？

content.text: And I think it's a basic human right personally.
content.trans: 我认为这是个人的基本人权。

content.text: So I think it's in the best interests of a country to invest in it because it means that
content.trans: 所以我认为一个国家应该投资它，因为这意味着

content.text: their people are more productive and happier and healthy.
content.trans: 他们的人民更高效、快乐和健康。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Alright, so that's all the time we have for today.
content.trans: 好的，今天我们今天的时长就这么多。

content.text: Be sure to come to EnglishPod.com, leave your questions and comments.
content.trans: 请务必访问英语Pod.com，留言和提问。

content.text: And we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 我们将在这里见到你们。

content.text: Bye everyone.
content.trans: Bye everyone. (翻译成中文：)
